description: Windows searched by the frozen pipeline in ALMA Bands 9 and 10 that the released catalogue omits. The export step recognised only the directory tags _B3 to _B8, so every Band 9 and Band 10 window was dropped before the catalogue was written. The omission is in the export, not the search: these windows were searched by the same frozen pipeline and their products exist. The bug is fixed at source; the next release folds them into the catalogue.
